comments.comment: [GOV-02] Creates a subordinate corps record, keeps a root-force pointer, assigns its direct governor, transfers selected cities/region buildings/units, and initializes funds, food and delegation fields.
[GOV-02] Chooses the default governor from serving people in the selected cities after excluding the ruler; the packed key prioritizes service status, martial office order and leadership.
[GOV-02] Effective leader accessor: primary records return their direct leader; subordinate records follow root_force_0B8, so this returns the polity ruler rather than the subordinate governor.
[GOV-02] Corps-person membership is queried through each person's effective owning object/corps; territory transfer therefore changes effective membership without a bulk person-record rewrite.
[GOV-02] Shared ownership transfer maintains city/unit lists and object corps references; cross-root transfers additionally run polity-side effects, while same-root corps edits preserve the polity.
[GOV-02] Merges all source people, units, cities, buildings, auxiliary references, funds and food into the destination, then clears references and resets the source record.
[GOV-02] Ordinary subordinate dissolution merges into root_force_0B8. A primary record is preserved by merging a child into it; only the terminal no-assets branch invokes full polity elimination.
[GOV-02] Before record reuse, clears every force-record root/auxiliary reference that still targets the retired record.
[GOV-02] Dialog command dispatcher. The mode selector maps 0=create, 1=modify and 2=dissolve; these labels match the command executor's three side-effect branches.
[GOV-02] Funds allocation is a conservation split between the delegated corps and ruler corps; accepted edits store complementary values.
[GOV-02] Food allocation is a conservation split between the delegated corps and ruler corps; accepted edits store complementary values.
